title: Etale sections over the base agree with sections over a flat quasi-compact cover with connected geometric fibres
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that for a flat quasi-compact morphism f : T -> S whose geometric fibres are connected, sections of an abelian sheaf on S_etale agree with sections of its inverse image over T (statement lines 5029-5038). The proof has three distinct parts: injectivity from surjectivity of f, a reduction of surjectivity to the equality of the two pullbacks to T x_S T via the fpqc description of pullbacks (proof lines 5047-5054), and the crux, the computation on a single geometric fibre where the restriction of F is a constant sheaf on the connected scheme T_{sbar}, so that every section is constant and both pullbacks correspond to the same element of F_{sbar} (proof lines 5055-5069). The non-formal content is this connectedness argument. The claim is H2: one descent reduction plus one geometric-fibre computation.
